title: Case: Cancelled order is packed but has not left the merchant warehouse
context: The merchant has authorised cancellation while the packed item is still in its warehouse. Warehouse stop confirmation is required before calling dispatch cancelled.
initial_request: Please get the warehouse to stop DL-9785 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Hi, any update on DL-75524? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
My parcel DL-96681 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Cancellation CAN-3193 is authorised for TG-9729 at 08:45 UTC today. DL-9785 is packed in outbound cage O7 and has no carrier handover scan. Refund processing is a separate task.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Route plan for depot BR-2 published for Thursday. 41 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Please get the warehouse to stop DL-9785 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the warehouse to stop dispatch using the merchant's recorded cancellation authority.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Whinmoor Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the warehouse to stop dispatch using the merchant's recorded cancellation authority. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Dispatch stop is not a refund approval, payment or completed customer communication.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Apply CAN-3193 to stop DL-9785 in cage O7 now. Please confirm physical removal from outbound dispatch and the resulting shipment status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-040: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
